outputs.headline: Unconfirmed: Image of Chandrayaan-3 celebrations lacks specific evidence
outputs.summary: We could not confirm if the image in the post shows people celebrating India's Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims the image shows people celebrating India's Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing.
outputs.what_is_true: Widespread celebrations took place across India on August 23, 2023, to mark the successful landing of the Chandrayaan-3 mission on the Moon, and these events were widely photographed by news agencies.
evidence_for: Mid-day.com published an article with multiple photos of people celebrating the Chandrayaan-3 moon landing across India on August 23, 2023.
Getty Images has numerous editorial photos from August 23, 2023, showing people celebrating the Chandrayaan-3 landing.
Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, about widespread excitement in India for the Chandrayaan-3 moon landing.
outputs.sources_spoken: Mid-day.com, Getty Images, and Al Jazeera
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that the image shows people celebrating India's Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing. We could not confirm this either way. What is true is that widespread celebrations took place across India on August 23, 2023, to mark the successful landing of the Chandrayaan-3 mission on the Moon, and these events were widely photographed by news agencies. We are not sure if the specific image in the post is from these celebrations. This information comes from reports by Mid-day.com, Getty Images, and Al Jazeera, which all show many photos of people celebrating the event.
